text: A particle of mass 2 kg is attached to one end of a light inextensible string of length 0.6 m. The other
end of the string is attached to a fixed point on a smooth horizontal surface. The particle is moving in a
circular path on the surface. The tension in the string is 20 N.
Find how many revolutions the particle makes per minute. [3]
